title: “God of mercy, help me trust You even when the path forward feels like leaving something precious behind.”
paragraphs: “God of mercy, help me trust You even when the path forward feels like leaving something precious behind.”
When I read the Bible, it feels like I am there—witnessing the truth unfold.

I’m crouched in the bushes, unseen, watching them leave Eden.
No thunder. No shouting. Just the sound of footsteps fading and a sword of fire turning slowly behind them.

What strikes me most isn’t anger—it’s grief.
A holy boundary is set, not to destroy, but to guard what cannot yet be returned to.

Even here, mercy lingers. God lets them live. God lets history continue.
And I wonder—what gardens have I stepped away from, and what grace still walks with me beyond the gate?
